dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Phlogiston Engraving is such a deep field of study. But... *sigh* kids these days...

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Greetings, outlander. This is the place where oblations are made to the Tablet of Tona.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: As to what the Tablet of Tona is, it is a symbol of the uniting bond between our tribes and the Sacred Flame.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Through the Flame, every native of Natlan can establish close connections with others in their tribe, Saurians, and the Pyro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: If the Flame's protection is your desire, then offer a prayer before the Tablet of Tona...

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Well, it's a pictogram created by the ancient people of Natlan by imitating a primeval language.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: They use these to communicate with phlogiston or interface with the Sacred Flame.

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: Graffiti has become more popular as time has passed...

dialogues.speaker: Keita
dialogues.text: But Phlogiston Engraving has some different connotations that few nowadays have the patience to study.
